title: Finite order of a nontrivial upper-half-plane expansion
statement: Let F,A:ℂ→ℂ. Suppose F is holomorphic on H={z:Im z>0}, F has a nonzero value in H, A is analytic at zero, and there exists Y₀∈ℝ such that F(z)=A(exp(2πiz)) whenever 0<Im z and Y₀≤Im z. Then analyticOrderAt A 0≠⊤.
lean_statement: ∀ (F A : ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∃ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im ∧ F z ≠ 0) → AnalyticAt ℂ A 0 → (∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Y₀ ≤ z.im → F z = A (Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * z))) → analyticOrderAt A 0 ≠ ⊤
